title: Saving with respect to Advocate General and Official Trustee.––Nothing in this Act shall
text:
15. Saving with respect to Advocate General and Official Trustee.––Nothing in this Act shall

be construed to impair the operation [of any enactment] for the time being in force, respecting the
authority of an Advocate General to act with respect to any charity [or of the Official Trustees
Act, 1913] respecting the vesting of property in trust for a charitable purpose in an Official Trustee.
